Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; out=[]

import itertools
for name in range(1,6):
    di=G[f'Demo pair {name} input']; do=G[f'Demo pair {name} output']
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
    sh=[]
    for s in comps(di):
        mn=(min(r for r,c in s), min(c for r,c in s))
        offs=sorted((r-mn[0],c-mn[1]) for r,c in s)
        typ='T' if offs==[(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,1)] else 'anti'
        sh.append((mn[0],mn[1],typ,offs))
    cells=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(do) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    A=sh; C=cells
    best=None
    for perm in itertools.permutations(range(len(C)), len(A)):
        tot=sum(abs(A[k][0]-C[perm[k]][0])+abs(A[k][1]-C[perm[k]][1]) for k in range(len(A)))
        if best is None or tot<best[0]: best=(tot,perm)
    tot,perm=best
    print(f'demo{name}: shape->cell (r,c,type,offs)->(r,c): total={tot}')
    for k in range(len(A)):
        ar,ac,atyp,aoff=A[k]; cr,cc=C[perm[k]]
        print('   ',(ar,ac,atyp,aoff),'->',(cr,cc))

def comps(g):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==2 and (i,j) not in seen:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); s=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); s.append((y,x))

                        if 0<=ny<len(g) and 0<=nx<len(g[0]) and g[ny][nx]==2 and (ny,nx) not in seen:

from collections import deque
import itertools
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
shapes=[]  # list of dicts
for n in range(1,8):
    di=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; do=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    cl=comps(di); h,w=len(di),len(di[0])
    cs=[(i,j) for i in range(3) for j in range(6) if do[i][j]!=0]
    M=[[abs(c[0]-s[0][0])+abs(c[1]-s[0][1]) for c in cs] for s in cl]
    minv=float('inf'); bestp=None
    for p in itertools.permutations(range(len(cs))):
        v=sum(M[i][p[i]] for i in range(len(cl)))
        if v<minv: minv=v; bestp=p
    for i,s in enumerate(cl):
        ys=[y for y,x in s]; xs=[x for y,x in s]
        ys0=min(ys); xs0=min(xs)
        y1=max(ys); x1=max(xs)
        ca=cs[bestp[i]]
        shapes.append(dict(TL=(ys0,xs0),BR=(y1,x1),center=(sum(ys)/len(s),sum(xs)/len(s)),assigned=(ca,do[ca[0]][ca[1]]),demo=n))
for s in shapes: print(s)
